findings.title: _md_cell does not escape backslash
findings.evidence: note `a\\|b` renders as `a\\\\|b`; the escaped pipe becomes a literal backslash plus a cell delimiter.

findings.title: getattr lint bypass is not documented
findings.evidence: No getattr/bypass limitation in references/ or SKILL.md; only in docs/remediation_plan.md (planning transcript). rev5 WP-5 assumed it was documented.
findings.fix: One line: lint is heuristic; dynamic dispatch can evade BANNED_*; safe_expr is the enforcement boundary.

findings.title: Nested brace expansion is incorrect
findings.evidence: `references/{a,{b,c}}.md` → ['a','b','a','c'] (duplicate, malformed). Flat braces used today, so no current false result.
findings.fix: Reject nested braces explicitly, or replace regex expansion with a small recursive parser.

findings.title: Partial output and temp-file leak on second write failure
findings.evidence: manifest.json path as directory → pages.txt written, temp file tmp… left behind, exit 2.
findings.fix: Write both files to temp, then replace; unlink temp in finally; or write manifest first and clean pages.txt on failure.

findings.title: Duplicate page specs accepted
findings.fix: Merge/dedupe ranges or reject overlapping specs.

findings.title: factorial(10000) yields ERROR not PASS/FAIL
findings.evidence: Allowed by cap, but formatting the 35k-digit result raises ValueError (int→str 4300-digit limit); check reports ERROR, exit 1 (fail-closed).
findings.fix: Avoid stringifying huge integers for the detail (use is_zero / truncate via a safe formatter), or lower the factorial cap.

findings.title: Hidden-path exclusion blinds the completeness check
findings.evidence: Adding scripts/__init__.py and scripts/.secret.py still exits 0: any package path component starting '.' or '__' is skipped.
findings.fix: Exclude only known artifact dirs (.git, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .venv) instead of all dot/dunder names.
